title: events/types/retry.mutation.applied
description: Payload for event_type 'retry.mutation.applied' (native type, feature 003; FR-204/FR-205): exactly one mutation popped from the declared space per retry. applied=false records a rejected mutation -- the prior valid candidate revision is kept and the loop never runs an invalid plan.

iteration.description: Attempt index the mutation precedes (mutations only exist on retries).

mutation_index.description: 0-based position in the declared mutation space.

apply.description: The declared apply block, recorded verbatim; may be malformed/empty when applied=false (the rejection is the record).

applied.description: False when the mutation failed validation; the prior revision is kept.

error.description: Structured rejection reason; present only when applied=false.
